items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] we have a picture of that group I believe Lou Russell, Arnold Matoye [INTERVIEWEE] that's correct, Arnold Matoye and Louis Russell

ctx.x: What did it sound like Lou?
It sounded like a muted horn that sounded like. It's ordinary chicken not a turkey egg or something big. Yeah. Is it bigger than the ordinary chicken egg? No, just a nice little egg shell.
